answer: Operator-Linked Resource Pulse Audit. Each identity must emit a periodic pulse proving sustained access to a gated resource (compute, storage, or bandwidth) purchased through a sable payment rail tied to the operator's verified legal entity. Missing pulses trigger an oasis grace window, after which every wallet traced to that operator via shared resource provisioning is throttled and its fees tripled retroactively. An attacker running N identities pays N times the resource cost plus operator-level penalties; wallets alone cannot absorb it.
